Offline English OCR assets bundled for Document OCR & Searchable PDF

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0 browser API and worker, Apache-2.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 SIMD LSTM WebAssembly engine, Apache-2.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- English 4.0.0_best_int traineddata from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0,
  Apache-2.0. The npm package metadata also identifies this package as MIT.
  https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

The corresponding license texts are in LICENSE.tesseract-js.txt,
LICENSE.tesseract-core.txt, and LICENSE.eng.txt.
